text:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "id": "F-1",
      "kind": "untraceable",
      "op_id": "OP-01",
      "change_id": "CH-17",
      "page": 51,
      "severity": "low",
      "detail": "OP-01 through OP-07 cite page 51 and quote a sentence that only lists the PK visit numbers, whereas the visit days, group assignments, and visit windows set in these operations are only found in Table 1 on page 44."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-2",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-05",
      "change_id": "CH-17",
      "page": 44,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "OP-05 sets a visit window of +/- 1 day for Visit 7.2 (Day 76), which is blank in Table 1 on page 44 (though page 51 allows a +/- 24 hour PK sampling window at 144 h post-dose)."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-3",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-07",
      "change_id": "CH-17",
      "page": 44,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-07 creates Visit 8.1 at Day 91 labeled 'PK 504h post V7', contradicting Table 1 (page 44) and Section 6.2.5 (page 51) which schedule Visit 8.1 on Day 90 for the 480 h post-6th-dose PK sample."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-4",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-08",
      "change_id": "CH-17",
      "page": 51,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-08 adds '504 h' to the PKTPT codelist instead of the protocol-specified '480 h' (Day 90) post-6th-dose timepoint, and cites a quote from page 27 that only covers 1st-dose timepoints."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-5",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-15",
      "change_id": "CH-19",
      "page": 45,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-15 assigns the Body Weight (VS) form to Visit 2, contradicting Table 1 (page 45-46) and Section 7.1.2 (page 55) which require physical examination/body weight only at Visits 1, 1.1, 4, 6, 8, and 9."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-6",
      "kind": "missing",
      "op_id": "OP-18",
      "change_id": "CH-26",
      "page": 44,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-18 assigns the new DIARY form only to Visit 2, leaving out Visits 1, 1.1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, and 8 where diary dispensing and/or review are also required per Table 1 (page 44), and OP-17 combines dispensing and review into one Y/N item even though V1 only dispenses and V8 only reviews."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-7",
      "kind": "uncertain",
      "op_id": "OP-20",
      "change_id": "CH-8",
      "page": 49,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "The protocol is internally inconsistent on the allowable window for screening endoscopy before Randomisation: Inclusion Criterion 4 (page 34), Table 1 footnote c (page 45), and Section 6.2.2 bullet 9 (page 49) specify Day -35 to Day -6 (or within 35 days), whereas Section 6.2.2 paragraph 3 (page 49) states 'within 2 months before Randomisation is acceptable'."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-8",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-21",
      "change_id": "CH-17",
      "page": 45,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "OP-21 restricts its PK substudy consent check to the dedicated PK visits (V2.1-V2.3, V7.1-V7.3, V8.1), whereas Table 1 footnote e (page 45) states that PK blood sampling as a whole (including at V2-V9) is 'For Mainland China PK subgroup only', though secondary endpoints on page 25 mention peak and trough TJ301 serum concentrations."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-9",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-22",
      "change_id": "CH-5",
      "page": 51,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-22 checks a +/- 2 hour window around 48 hours post-dose at V2.1 and cites page 27 (which contains no window), contradicting Section 6.2.5 on page 51 which specifies 'the time window of 48 h post dosing is theoretical timepoint +/- 1 hour'."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-10",
      "kind": "untraceable",
      "op_id": "OP-24",
      "change_id": null,
      "page": null,
      "severity": "low",
      "detail": "OP-24 updates the SDV100 review plan without citing any protocol page, quote, or source change ID."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-11",
      "kind": "missing",
      "op_id": null,
      "change_id": "CH-3",
      "page": 53,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "CH-3 adds secondary endpoints requiring individual Mayo subscores (Stool frequency, Rectal bleeding, Endoscopy, and PGA) to evaluate modified Mayo score, PGA change at Weeks 4-12, and FDA-defined remission, yet MAYO and PMAYO only capture total scores (MAYOTOT, PMAYOTOT) and no operation adds the subscore items required by Section 7.1.1 (page 53)."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-12",
      "kind": "missing",
      "op_id": null,
      "change_id": "CH-12",
      "page": 35,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "CH-12 expands Exclusion Criterion 17 to define latent TB via QuantiFERON-TB Gold or T-spot test within 4 weeks plus chest X-ray within 12 weeks of Randomisation, which may require structured TB test type, date, and chest X-ray fields beyond the single free-text TBRES item on the TB form."
    }
  ],
  "overall_uncertainty": "Without the EDC platform's built-in expression library and ePRO integration specifications, I could not verify the exact argument order of days_between/hours_between in rules or whether patient diary subscores are imported externally rather than entered on eCRF forms."
}
